extraction.Name: Joseph Brown
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment, covering NEZ3Sec.31, T.40N. R.36W. and NW2 of NWA,Sec.21 & NEl of NEl & Si of NEL,Sec.20,7.43N. R.37W., making 320 acres, but that he was told that he would have to accept it, and pay taxes whether he wanted to or not, so he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: got behind in the taxes, selling one quarter for taxes, and turned the other one over for a store debt
extraction.Buyer: Ed Collins, of Merriman, Nebraska (received one quarter for a store debt)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in the taxes, selling one quarter for taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: the only source of his income is the money he gets off of leasing his childrens' land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is fairly good for one of his years, but sight is very defective, cannot even see to read; has a wife and three minor children to support; wife's health is not very good, having rheumatism and gall stone troubles; health of the children is good; all together they have a very hard time getting along; never received any aid from the County or Government; never mortgaged the half section of land; allotment covers NEZ3 Sec.31, T.40N. R.36W. and NW2 of NWA, Sec.21 & NEl of NEl & Si of NEL, Sec.20, T.43N. R.37W., making 320 acres; document sworn November 16, 1928
